audit_timing: recorded while recovered parent G2 f2/f3 were still in progress and before any terminal G2 group classification
frozen_geometry: flat (M21 case files do not override curvature; provider default Omega_k=0 / sgnK=0)

source_facts.transfer_q_definition: In the exact provider transfer module, wavenumbers are called q; in flat universes k=q. The transfer module precomputes Delta_l^X(q).
source_facts.flat_q_branch: The exact transfer q-grid constructor has an explicit sgnK==0 flat branch for q_min/q_max.
source_facts.closed_trapezoidal_branch: q_logstep_trapzd and the associated q_numstep_transition smoothing are used in the sgnK==1 closed-curvature branch, including integer-nu handling before the flat approximation.
source_facts.flat_hyperspherical_sampling: The flat spherical-Bessel interpolation structure is created with hyper_sampling_flat and hyper_phi_min_abs.
source_facts.curved_hyperspherical_sampling: hyper_sampling_curved_low_nu/high_nu and hyper_nu_sampling_step are used in the curved hyperspherical path.

G2A.interpretation: Perturbation k-range/density changes are active in the frozen scalar flat run.

G2B.interpretation: If G2B is sufficient in flat M21, attribution must be capped to the active flat multipole/Bessel sampling content unless later instrumentation separates individual parameters.

G2C.interpretation: In flat M21, G2C is effectively a transfer-wavenumber q linear/log-spline sampling test; closed-universe trapezoidal controls cannot receive causal credit.

governance: Do not alter the preregistered G2 or stage2 subgroup files. This audit only caps later causal wording for the flat frozen case; the frozen subgroup execution and thresholds remain unchanged.
